question: Q-N-M1-D1
text: Distinct OD pairs by payment type for 2024, alongside the overall total (which is less than the sum of payment types).
interpretation: Distinct OD pairs by payment type for 2024 (grain 'payment_type'), the overall total (grain 'total') and the sum of the payment-type values (grain 'sum_of_members'), which exceeds the total because one pair occurs under several payment types.
assemble: SELECT grain, payment_type_name, distinct_od_pairs FROM ( SELECT 'payment_type' AS grain, payment_type_name, distinct_od_pairs FROM types WHERE trips > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'total', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), distinct_od_pairs FROM total WHERE trips > 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'sum_of_members', CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR), SUM(distinct_od_pairs) FROM types WHERE trips > 0 ) r ORDER BY grain, payment_type_name NULLS FIRST
note: sum_of_members adds the per-type distinct counts Tableau returned, to show they exceed the total.
